en.name: Powdered coffee creamer
en.summary: Powdered coffee creamer is a dried blend of vegetable fat, glucose syrup solids and milk proteins that whitens coffee without refrigeration. Unopened, it keeps about 2 years from purchase in a dry cupboard; once opened, use it within 2–3 months for decent flavour.
en.pantry: The cupboard is where this belongs. Store it in a dry, cool place away from the kettle, the cooker and the sink, because steam is the only real enemy of a low-moisture powder. Unopened tubs and sachets run about 2 years from the date of purchase. After opening, aim to finish it within 2–3 months: the fat in it oxidises once air gets at it, and the powder starts to clump and taste stale long before anything unsafe happens. Keep the lid screwed on tight and the scoop out of the tub between uses.
en.fridge: There is no refrigerated timeline for powdered creamer, and the fridge is actually the wrong place for it. Every time a cold tub comes out into a warm kitchen, moisture condenses on the powder, and damp powder cakes, then goes musty. Keep it in the cupboard instead. The exception is liquid creamer, which is a different product entirely and must be refrigerated once opened.
en.freezer: Freezing is unnecessary and counterproductive. The powder is already dry enough to be shelf-stable, and the freezer adds nothing but condensation every time you open the bag. There is no freezer timeline for it. If you find yourself with far more than you can use, decant it into smaller airtight jars so the bulk of it stays sealed, rather than putting any of it in the freezer.
spoilage: Hard lumps or a solid cake that will not break up with a spoon.
A stale, crayon-like or paint-like smell — the fat has gone rancid.
Powder that no longer dissolves and leaves a scum on the coffee.
Any mould, or an off colour where moisture has got in.
tips: Buy the size you will get through in a couple of months once opened.
Never use a wet spoon; one damp scoop cakes the whole tub.
Decant a bulk bag into small jars and keep the rest sealed.
Write the opening date on the lid.

faq.q: How long does powdered coffee creamer last?
faq.a: About 2 years from purchase unopened, in a dry cupboard, and 2–3 months once opened.

faq.q: Does powdered creamer need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No, and it is better not to. Condensation on a cold powder makes it cake and go musty. Liquid creamer is another matter and must be kept cold.
There is no timeline for it and no reason to. It is already shelf-stable, and freezing only invites moisture.

faq.q: Why has my creamer gone lumpy?
faq.a: Moisture, almost always from a damp spoon or a lid left off near steam. Hard cakes that will not break up should be thrown out.

zh.name: 奶精粉
zh.summary: 奶精粉是以植物油脂、葡萄糖漿固形物和乳蛋白調製乾燥而成的粉末，不需冷藏就能讓咖啡變白。未開封放在乾燥櫥櫃，從購買日起約 2 年；開封後請在 2～3 個月內用完，風味才不會走掉。
zh.pantry: 櫥櫃就是它該待的地方。放在乾燥陰涼處，遠離熱水瓶、爐火和水槽，因為對低水分粉末來說，水蒸氣才是唯一真正的敵人。未開封的罐裝或隨身包，從購買日起約 2 年。開封後請以 2～3 個月內用完為目標：一旦接觸空氣，裡面的油脂就開始氧化，粉末會先結塊、再出現走味，而這遠比任何安全問題來得早。蓋子每次都旋緊，湯匙不要留在罐子裡。
zh.fridge: 奶精粉沒有冷藏期限，而且冰箱其實是錯的地方。每次把冰過的罐子拿到溫暖的廚房，水氣就會在粉末上凝結，受潮的粉會先結塊、然後發霉走味。請放櫥櫃就好。例外是液態奶精，那是完全不同的產品，開封後必須冷藏。
zh.freezer: 冷凍既沒必要也幫倒忙。這種粉本來就乾到可以常溫保存，放冷凍庫只會在每次開袋時多一次結露。它沒有冷凍期限。如果買到的量遠超過你用得掉的，請分裝成幾個小密封罐，讓大部分維持密封狀態，而不是把它塞進冷凍庫。
spoilage: 結成湯匙壓不散的硬塊或整片結餅。
聞起來有陳味、蠟筆味或油漆味——油脂已經油耗。
粉末不再溶解，在咖啡表面浮出一層渣。
長霉，或受潮處出現異常顏色。
tips: 買開封後兩三個月內用得完的容量。
絕對不要用濕湯匙；一匙水氣就會讓整罐結塊。
大包裝分裝成小罐，其餘保持密封。

faq.a: 未開封放乾燥櫥櫃，從購買日起約 2 年；開封後 2～3 個月。
不需要，而且最好不要。冰過的粉末容易結露、結塊發霉。液態奶精則相反，開封後必須冷藏。
沒有對應期限，也沒有必要。它本來就可以常溫保存，冷凍只會帶來水氣。
幾乎都是受潮，通常來自濕湯匙或蓋子沒蓋又靠近蒸氣。壓不散的硬塊請丟掉。
